payload.title: Implement timezone and DST handling without new dependencies
payload.description:
Implement wall-clock to UTC conversion using Intl DateTimeFormat timezone offsets (the standard offset-probing technique) — no new runtime dependencies (the repo keeps zod, yaml, tree-sitter only) and no Temporal (not in the supported Node). DST rules: calendar windows on transition days are naturally 23h or 25h; a day-start inside the spring-forward gap resolves to the first valid instant after the gap; a day-start inside the fall-back ambiguity resolves to the earlier occurrence. Invalid IANA timezone names fail fast.

Done when: the DST gap and ambiguity rules are implemented as documented and the function is pure and deterministic.
